text:
claire: FYI I'm seeing flaky anchor failures in the MkDocs pipeline after moving the networking section. Build log shows `Duplicate ID 'networking-setup'` and then the nav generator throws `TOC generation failed`.

tim: Can you paste the problematic headings?

claire: Two headings: `## Networking - Setup` and `## Networking — Setup` (one hyphen, one em-dash). Both slug to the same id. Also one link uses `/docs/networking#networking-setup%20guide` (note the %20).

maya: Short fixes: add explicit ids on the headings like `## Networking - Setup {#networking-setup}` and replace encoded links with `#networking-setup`. Also remove inline code spans from headings where possible.

claire: I'll patch PR #512 with the heading ids and update internal links.

ci-bot: CI: docs/build started for PR #512 (branch: docs/anchor-cleanup).

tim: For longer term: let's add `mkdocs build --strict` to the docs CI and a step to grep for `Duplicate ID` in mkdocs output and fail. That will catch these earlier.

maya: Agreed. Also adding a small Python script to scan markdown for similar slugs might help pre-commit.

claire: Patch pushed, CI passed and preview looks good. I'll also add a note in the contributor guide to use explicit `{#id}` when renaming headings that might be linked externally. Closing thread.
